note: Adapted from entry 51 (pp. 356–360) of Roonwal & Chhotani (1997), originally in English; it records three castes, the alate, the soldier and the pseudoworker, the last included here under the “Worker” heading. The synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, type specimens and distribution information of the original have not been entered. Suspected OCR errors (e.g. “1 l>segmented”) have been read as 11-segmented from the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: head capsule, postclypeus and mandibles dark reddish brown, antennae, labrum and maxillary palps deep golden yellow; body length (without wings) 4.90 mm, head length (to mandibular base) and head width (including the compound eyes) both 0.95 mm. Soldier: anterior part of the head capsule dark brown, the anterolateral margins concave in front of the antennae and then produced laterally into angular processes, which are prolongations of the genae; body length about 6.15–6.65 mm, head length (to mandibular base) 1.68–1.77 mm, width 1.23–1.30 mm, mandible length 1.17–1.23 mm; postmentum goblet-shaped, widest before the posterior half, maximum width 0.46–0.47 mm, waist width 0.15–0.17 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, postclypeus and mandibles dark reddish brown; antennae, labrum and maxillary palps deep golden yellow; thorax and dorsum of the abdomen darker, the venter paler; legs pale reddish brown. Head and body covered with pale yellow hairs, rather densely. Body length (without wings) 4.90 mm. Head slender, oval; head length (to mandibular base) 0.95 mm, equal to the head width including the compound eyes, 0.95 mm; the Y-shaped suture appears only at the posterior part, as a single longitudinal line. Compound eyes large, oval (maximum diameter 0.29 mm, minimum diameter 0.25 mm), close to the antennae. Ocelli elongate-oval, small (long diameter 0.10 mm, short diameter 0.06 mm), 0.02 mm from the compound eye. Antennae with more than 8 segments, segments 4 and 5 subequal and shortest. Anteclypeus trapezoidal, transparent, bare; postclypeus also trapezoidal, indistinctly delimited from the frontal area, with a few short hairs on the anterior margin. Labrum broad, ligulate (length 0.2 mm, width 0.33 mm). Pronotum flat, much wider than long (length 0.58 mm, width 0.93 mm), as wide as the head including the compound eyes; anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short and stout, tibial apical spurs 3:3:3; abdomen elongate-oval, cerci 2-segmented, length 0.08 mm, styli single-segmented, length 0.06 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Anterior part of the head capsule dark brown, the posterior part paler; antennae golden yellow, segment 3 darker; labrum pale yellow, semitransparent; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base; pronotum yellowish brown; abdomen and legs yellow. Head and body with moderate hair. Body length about 6.15–6.65 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, much longer than wide (head length to mandibular base 1.68–1.77 mm, width 1.23–1.30 mm); the sides nearly straight, concave in front of the antennae and then produced laterally into angular processes (prolongations of the genae); the frons inclined forwards and separated from the vertex by a distinct ridge, the middle of the ridge depressed into a short shallow groove; posterior margin convex. Compound eyes small, oval, semitransparent (maximum diameter 0.13–0.14 mm, minimum diameter 0.05–0.07 mm), 0.10 mm from the antennae; ocelli absent. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 3 long and club-shaped, segment 4 shortest. Anteclypeus thin, bare; postclypeus trapezoidal, almost indistinguishable from the frons. Labrum much wider than long (length 0.10–0.17 mm, width 0.30–0.33 mm), nearly rectangular, the anterior margin slightly convex and bearing 2 pairs of long setae. Mandibles stout, long (1.17–1.23 mm), pointed and strongly incurved at the apex, with a weak swelling at the base of the outer margin; left mandible with 2 large marginal teeth and 1–2 small serrations at the base; right mandible with 2 weak serrations on the distal half and 1 sharp tooth near the base. Postmentum rather long, about 2/3 of the head capsule length (median length 1.13–1.18 mm), goblet-shaped, widest in the anterior half, with a narrow waist (maximum width 0.46–0.47 mm, waist width 0.15–0.17 mm). Pronotum flat, much wider than long, nearly kidney-shaped, slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin moderately concave, posterior margin nearly round. Legs short, femora slightly inflated and darker; tibial apical spurs 3:3:3; abdomen long, hairy, cerci 2-segmented, length 0.10–0.15 mm, styli single-segmented, length 0.10 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Called a pseudoworker in the original. Head capsule, antennae, labrum, clypeus and mandibles pale yellow, the toothed edge of the mandibles dark brown; thorax and body pale yellowish white. Head and body with moderate hair. Body length 4.50–5.00 mm. Head nearly circular, wider than long (length 1.07–1.10 mm, width 1.13–1.27 mm). Compound eyes reduced, small, oval (maximum diameter 0.13 mm, minimum diameter 0.10 mm), semitransparent to pale brown; ocelli absent. Antennae very short, 11–12-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal, bare; postclypeus nearly rectangular, flat, with a few hairs on the margins. Labrum broad, ligulate (length 0.28–0.33 mm, width 0.40–0.47 mm). Pronotum nearly rectangular to crescent-shaped, wider than long (width 0.90–1.00 mm, length 0.60 mm), narrower than the head; anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin nearly straight with a weak median concavity. Mesonotum wider than the pronotum, and metanotum wider than the mesonotum.
